theses.subject: Silver & Royalties

The detector's only validated edge is drawdown risk control via the absolute-trend gate, so the lean is a trend-continuation posture with vol-aware de-risking — not a return forecast. Durability benefit sits with broad participation but a low durability_bar (0.61) and mean-revert Hurst tag argue the leadership may be choppy rather than cleanly trending.
